tasks.done_when: Learner asked about refund policy for cancelled classes.

Japanese.goal: 受講者が少なくて授業が中止になった場合の返金の決まりについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 返金の保証について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if station includes high-power induction cooktops or gas burners
tasks.hint: Inquire about cooktop heating technology.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about induction cooktop vs gas burner stations.

Japanese.goal: 作業台のコンロが高出力のIHかガスか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: コンロの加熱の仕組みについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request written conversion table for metric and imperial kitchen measurements
tasks.hint: Ask instructor for measurement conversion sheet.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested written measurement conversion table.

Japanese.goal: メートル法とヤード・ポンド法の分量の換算表を紙でお願いする
Japanese.hint: 計量の換算表をもらえるよう講師に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Report missing kitchen timer and ask instructor for spare timer
tasks.hint: Inform instructor station has no timer.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing kitchen timer and asked for spare.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital food scales and glass measuring cups stand neatly arranged on granite counters.

Japanese.goal: キッチンタイマーがないことを伝えて、予備のタイマーをお願いする
Japanese.hint: 作業台にタイマーがないと講師に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if students can practice flame browning with blowtorches
tasks.hint: Inquire about using culinary torches for desserts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about practicing flame browning with blowtorches.

Japanese.goal: バーナーで焼き色をつける練習ができるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: デザートに料理用バーナーを使えるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about food safety training modules like ServeSafe certification options
tasks.hint: Ask if class offers formal food handler certificate.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about food safety certification modules.
tasks.scene_hint: Freshly printed recipe binders sit beside clean embroidered white aprons on reception bench.

Japanese.goal: サーブセーフなどの食品衛生の資格講座について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 授業で正式な食品取扱者の資格が取れるか聞きましょう。
